descriptionChirho: Adjective denoting one who is deficient, needy, or devoid of something, used in construct with what is lacking (especially chasar-lev 'lacking sense/heart'); dominant in Proverbs for moral and intellectual deficiency, but also of material want or physical lack; covers adjectival, verbal, and nominal uses of the same root meaning (1 Sam 21:15; 1 Kgs 11:22; 17:16; 2 Sam 3:29; Prov 6:32; 7:7; 9:4, 16; 10:13, 21; 11:12; 12:9, 11; 15:21; 17:18; 24:30; 28:16; Eccl 6:2; 10:3).
